question: D172 asked whether diffusion_transformer's 8.1943 at model scope is a real defect or an artifact of the capture the charter's arm used. Answered on CPU from artifacts already on disk, with no card.
answer: AN ARTIFACT, and the variable is named. The two arms use the SAME capture (/home/ttuser/of3t_softgrad/diffcap043), the SAME 547 tensors, the SAME model denominator, and the SAME reference -- per-tensor ref_norm agrees to a ratio of exactly 1.0000 on every diffusion_transformer tensor. The only difference either artifact records is D56: arm A has softmax_bw_renorm_asked/live BOTH NULL (it predates the instrumentation, so it ran without the repair), arm B records asked=false live=TRUE, which is the composition's default-ON since pass 274.

where_it_sits.note: MODEL_shipped.json's own worst_tensor field already named this tensor at 18.5040. What nobody had done is weight it: it is 94 % of the section and the section is the whole model-scope error.

projected_model_scope.method: SUBSTITUTION, not a re-run: MODEL_shipped's per-section table with the six sections arm B covers replaced by arm B's own mass-weighted values, composed on squared mass shares. Legitimate because capture, reference, denominator and tensor set are identical; it is still a projection and of3t-ditmodel owns the real re-take.
